correctness.rationale: The complete geometric fixed-point complex is homeomorphic to the admissible graph-orbit independence complex by orbit-constant barycentric coordinates, with normalization by orbit sizes. An exhaustive involution classification in D_n x C_2 reduces the orbit graph to an open ladder for four reflection-axis/twist types; to the ordinary or Möbius ladder for half-turns; and to an empty model for pure layer exchange. Exact orbit-edge equalities follow from graph adjacency at reflected column pairs. For open ladders, the link of a_2 is a cone because b_1 is isolated after deleting N[a_2]; folding b_2 from G-a_2 using N(a_1)={b_1} subset N(b_2)={b_1,b_3} leaves K_2 disjoint union L_{m-2}, hence a suspension. The base cases m=1,2 are \(S^0\); the recurrence yields the claimed integer dimensions. The remaining ordinary homotopy types are precisely Theorems 12 and 15 of Agarwal--Basak, which have been inspected at pages 8 and 10. The standalone package verifier independently reconstructed original edges and orbit quotients (70 models, n=5..18) and all mod-two Betti numbers of 50 quotient complexes (n=5..14). This is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The published 2026 circular/Mobius ladder theorems give nonequivariant homotopy classifications, and a close public mathematical record gives rational homology characters and a path-orbit count for plain reflections. Neither statement gives the complete geometric involution-fixed homotopy types, especially the twisted reflections, the two half-turn quotient graph identifications, or the exact fixed sphere dimensions. For n=12 the ordinary rational character has the same reflection trace for both axes, while the new fixed spaces are \(S^3\) and \(S^1\); thus even the full previously known character does not imply the asserted fixed-space topology. General orbit-space modeling is elementary and is credited rather than presented as original. No equivalent stronger all-involution classification was found after actual published-finding corpus searches, inspection of the closest public record and full text of the motivating preprint. Residual unindexed overlap is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed equivariant or graph-complex source may derive the same full involution-fixed homotopy classification.

value.rationale: The family is a natural cyclic prism graph family whose ordinary independence homotopy types were newly classified in 2026, but those types and even the full rational group representation do not determine the topology of individual geometric fixed spaces. The theorem classifies every order-two symmetry without exceptional missing lengths for all n>=5; its sphere dimensions vary with reflection axis and the layer twist, and its two half-turn cases produce genuinely different family types. At n=12 two reflections have identical rational homology traces but fixed spaces \(S^3\) versus \(S^1\), a concrete non-implied integral homotopy distinction. The result is a natural complete classification, not arbitrary parameter slicing, and offers boundary conditions for future full equivariant classifications.
